lm74700_ds.title: LM74700-Q1 Low IQ Reverse Battery Protection Ideal Diode Controller
lm74700_ds.where: Fetched from ti.com's lit/pdf link with wget (jlc_parts.py fetch). The PDF was built on 9 January 2026 (its package option addendum carries that date), but the datasheet text is Revision G, December 2020.
lm74700_ds.note: 36 PDF pages. Printed page numbers 1-25 equal the PDF page numbers; then the package option addendum (Addendum-Page 1-2, PDF pp.26-27, dated 9-Jan-2026, LM74700QDBVRQ1 Active), packaging materials (PDF pp.28-29), the DDF0008A outline, example board layout and stencil (PDF pp.30-32), the DBV0006A outline, example board layout and stencil (PDF pp.33-35) and the notice (PDF p.36). The text layer is clean: the micro sign extracts as 'µ' and minus signs as '–'. The first page sets two columns side by side, so -layout interleaves them line by line; nothing is quoted from p.1. Table cells (§6 Specifications) are cited as figures, not quotes.

tmg08n10si_ds.title: TMG08N10SI N-Channel Enhancement Mosfet
tmg08n10si_ds.where: LCSC's datasheet link for C7422896 (jlc_parts.py fetch C7422896). The maker publishes no revision letter.
tmg08n10si_ds.note: 5 pages, numbered 1/5-5/5. p.1 ratings and the SOT-89-3L pin drawing (G, D, S, with the tab on D; its letters are in the text layer but the drawing is an image), p.2 electrical characteristics, pp.3-4 typical curves, p.5 the SOT-89-3L mechanical drawing (an image, no text). The text layer renders milliohm as 'mW' on p.1 and 'mΩ' on p.2.
